# ERS TECH

> ERS TECH is your partner for software innovation, offering an IT guide to a vast variety of organizations throughout the world. We deliver tailored tech solutions in app development, blockchain, and software, backed by 10 years of experience, 50+ experts, 600+ completed projects, 100+ positive reviews, 100+ happy clients, and 97% customer satisfaction.

  - [BCCoin](https://erstech.org/portfolio/bccoin): Staking Platform & Crypto Banking Ecosystem offering debit cards and referral rewards.
  - [A-Bot](https://erstech.org/portfolio/a-bot): AI-Powered Crypto Agent for Telegram with wallet operations, trading, and AML verification.
  - [QuikiPay](https://erstech.org/portfolio/quikipay): Global Payment Gateway Provider supporting credit cards, crypto, and merchant settlement automation.
  - [LiftSplit](https://erstech.org/portfolio/liftsplit): Smart Ride-Sharing & Commute Platform featuring dual-role driver/rider accounts and in-app wallet.

  - [Card Access](https://erstech.org/portfolio/card-access): Crypto Card FinTech Platform with mediator admin controls, multi-tier commissions, and cardholder portal.
